# Provider logos

Provider names and logos are the trademarks of their owners. Stowbox uses
them only to name the provider a box belongs to, and does not imply any
endorsement.

Each mark ships as `src/assets/providers/<id>.svg`. The shapes are the
provider's own; the only change is that fills are `currentColor`, because the
UI is monochrome, and Daytona's embedded `<style>` is removed. A provider
without a file here is shown as a monogram in a square.

Downloaded on 2026-11-19.

| Provider | Source | Brand guidelines |
|---|---|---|
| boxd | <https://boxd.sh/favicon.svg> | None published that we could find |
| boat | <https://boat.dev/icon.svg> | None published that we could find |
| Daytona | <https://www.daytona.io/favicon.svg> | <https://www.daytona.io/brand>: the glyph is the form meant for UI with limited space |
| Agent37 | <https://www.agent37.com/logo.svg> | None published that we could find |

## Harness marks

An agent's tab shows the mark of the coding agent it runs, from
`src/assets/harnesses/<harness>.svg`. Claude, Claude Code, OpenAI and Codex
are trademarks of their owners; the shapes are theirs, filled with
`currentColor`. Downloaded on 2026-11-20.

| Harness | Source | Change |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | <https://claude.ai/favicon.svg> | Fill set to `currentColor` |
| Codex | <https://developers.openai.com/favicon.svg> (the OpenAI blossom) | Blue background circle removed, fill set to `currentColor`, viewBox cropped to the mark |

The SSH host is not a company, so it has no logo: `sshhost.svg` is Lucide's
`server` icon, under the ISC license in `third-party/lucide-LICENSE`.
